title.zh-Hans: 创建MySQL实例并绑定账号数据库
title.en-US: Create MySQL Instance with Account-Database Binding

overview.zh-Hans: 此示例演示如何创建PolarDB MySQL实例，并使用account_database_binding资源创建数据库、账号并绑定权限。
overview.en-US: This example demonstrates how to create a PolarDB MySQL instance and create databases, accounts, and bind privileges using the account_database_binding resource.
